evaluation_protocol.scope: 22 unchanged captured events, fixed purpose-v2 EP01 E01-E19 / EP02 E20-E22, gpt-5-mini, 3 independent full runs; additional independent synthetic domains once each
evaluation_protocol.adjudication: Human-readable manual semantic assessment of text, type, speaker, selected source quotes and full user context. Store per-target and per-object labels with reasons; do not call keyword checks semantic accuracy. This is developer assessment, not blinded external review.
evaluation_protocol.recall: A target requires correct type/speaker, semantically present text and direct evidence from the specified user turn. Partial or embedded in a generic question is reported separately, not full typed recall. One compound object may express multiple distinct facts; it is not multiple independent objects.
evaluation_protocol.precision: For decisions and open_question, all emitted objects of that type are the denominator (including assistant/source objects). Decision must explicitly adopt/reject, not defer; open_question must remain unresolved and be user-owned. Duplicate true paraphrases count as supported but are separately counted redundant.
evaluation_protocol.speaker_accuracy: Evaluate ownership claimed in the text against direct selected speech, in addition to deterministic field/speaker consistency. Unknown is not scored correct ownership.
evaluation_protocol.semantic_support: Check all material claims, type, relevant selected spans, negation, temporal status and adoption. Report developer-supported fraction and uncertain separately. Existing model_supported is not ground truth or objective verification.
evaluation_protocol.unnecessary_duplicates: Object repeats another without a distinct speech act/information contribution, repeats AI recommendations, or contains off-purpose technical detail. Record object IDs and reasons; do not use object count alone.
evaluation_protocol.completion: Full run completes only when every episode validates. Failed run contributes zero accepted objects and zero operational target recall; report completed-only quality separately so failures cannot disappear from results.
evaluation_protocol.literal_match: All selected refs must pass exact UTF-16 source slice and substring checks; report matched refs / emitted refs.
evaluation_protocol.cost: Sum all recorded input/output/total usage including repairs and support review, report per-run elapsed milliseconds and API calls; unknown API usage remains unknown.
evaluation_protocol.no_tuning: Do not change classification or evaluation thresholds after these runs start. Preserve all failed candidates and raw calls. A new implementation requires a separate output directory/protocol.
evaluation_protocol.limits: Historical different-size samples and one session cannot establish general improvement or isolate policy causality; synthetic independent cases are smoke tests, not a population benchmark. No relationship graph scoring.

comparator.kind: historical grounding-v2 3 repeats plus original extraction-v1; see frozen evaluation protocol
comparator.extra_ep02_diagnostic: separate scope, not a completed full run

design: Three sequential independent extractions by default, no checkpoint reuse between repeats. No DB writes. No change to thresholds after observing results. Same source session is not a general reliability benchmark.
metrics: candidate_count is the first parsed object-slot count. validated_count requires literal/author checks and model support review. failed_count is unresolved final slots. Error counts count occurrences, not unique objects. Whole-run accepted count is zero when the run fails. model_supported is not semantic truth verification.
